prerequisites: It is recommended to have the competencies taught in the modules Algorithms and Data Structures and Database Systems.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can assess the performance of database systems.
Students can apply techniques for developing efficient data structures and algorithms in database systems.
Students can evaluate external data structures regarding runtime, memory space, and throughput.
Students can handle index structures in commercial database systems.
Students have knowledge of query optimization techniques and their availability in commercial systems.
Students can describe architectures of modern database systems.

syllabus_topics: One-dimensional index structures: B-trees and hashing methods
Lock protocols and recovery for index structures

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions to at least two exercise assignments
Oral examination (individual examination) or written examination

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments must be achieved, along with an oral presentation of the solution to at least two exercise assignments. The final grade is awarded from 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program, based on an oral examination or a written exam.
bibliography: Härder, Rahm: Datenbanksysteme. Konzepte und Techniken der Implementierung, Springer.
Saake, Heuer, Sattler: Datenbanken: Implementierungstechniken, Mitp.
Garcia-Molina, Ullman, Widom: Database System Implementation, Prentice Hall.
